phoneticConvention: Syllable-by-syllable romaji for English readers, in the deck's style (so-o-de-su, ko-wa-i-de-su). Read each syllable as in Spanish or Italian: a as in 'father', i as in 'machine', u as in 'put', e as in 'bet', o as in 'go'. A long vowel is written twice (ko-o-hi-i, to-o-kyo-o); ん is its own beat written n (su-mi-ma-se-n, ko-n-ni-chi-wa); a doubled consonant closes the syllable before it (kip-pu, chot-to, kek-ko-o). The u of de-su / ma-su is almost silent ('dess', 'mass'); r is a light tap between r and l; g is always hard. The reading field gives the hiragana. Polite register (です / ます) throughout.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended; linguistic review required (naturalness of phrasing, kanji readings).
title: Explaining and comparing
goal: Explain a reason, compare and express a preference.

model.phon: {s} ka-ra, kyo-o wa i-e ni i-ma-su
model.reading: {s}から、きょうはいえにいます。

turns.study: そうですか。田中さんは車で来ますか。
turns.reading: そうですか。たなかさんはくるまできますか。
turns.phon: so-o de-su ka. ta-na-ka-sa-n wa ku-ru-ma de ki-ma-su ka
turns.native: I see. Do you come by car?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: いいえ、電車で来ます。電車の方が速いと思います。
turns.reading: いいえ、でんしゃできます。でんしゃのほうがはやいとおもいます。
turns.phon: i-i-e, de-n-sha de ki-ma-su. de-n-sha no ho-o ga ha-ya-i to o-mo-i-ma-su
turns.native: No, I come by train. I think the train is faster.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 私は自転車です。安いし、健康にいいからです。
turns.reading: わたしはじてんしゃです。やすいし、けんこうにいいからです。
turns.phon: wa-ta-shi wa ji-te-n-sha de-su. ya-su-i shi, ke-n-ko-o ni i-i ka-ra de-su
turns.native: I come by bike. Because it's cheap and good for your health.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: いいですね。前は私も自転車に乗っていましたが、今は遠いので電車です。
turns.reading: いいですね。まえはわたしもじてんしゃにのっていましたが、いまはとおいのででんしゃです。
turns.phon: i-i de-su ne. ma-e wa wa-ta-shi mo ji-te-n-sha ni not-te i-ma-shi-ta ga, i-ma wa to-o-i no-de de-n-sha de-su
turns.native: That's nice. I used to ride a bike too, but now it's far, so I take the train.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: 引っ越しましたか。
turns.reading: ひっこしましたか。
turns.phon: hik-ko-shi-ma-shi-ta ka
turns.native: Did you move?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: はい、去年、郊外に引っ越しました。静かで、家が広いです。
turns.reading: はい、きょねん、こうがいにひっこしました。しずかで、いえがひろいです。
turns.phon: ha-i, kyo-ne-n, ko-o-ga-i ni hik-ko-shi-ma-shi-ta. shi-zu-ka de, i-e ga hi-ro-i de-su
turns.native: Yes, last year I moved to the suburbs. It's quiet and the house is big.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Justify with から and ので, compare with より and の方が, give an opinion (と思います) and a reasoned preference (の方が好きです。…からです), explain a change (前は…ていましたが、今は…).
